newsitem.title: USA: Carver sees greater than expected Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Carver sees greater than expected Q4 loss.

text.p: Carver Corp said Friday it expects recent snow storms in the Pacific Northwest to hurt its fourth quarter and full-year revenues.
The company said it had already expected to post a loss for those periods because of a delay in one of its vendors in shipping two key audio products.
It said the storms, which disrupted Carver's operations and caused a roof section at its manufacturing and corporate headquarters to collapse, are expected to exacerbate the situation.

"Our revenue shortfall and resultant loss will be larger because the recent storms temporarily disrupted our operations during one of our busiest times of the year," President and Chief Executive Stephen Williams said in a statement.

Williams said a storm-related closure also delayed product design and production schedules for certain new loudspeakers the electronics company had planned to release at a show on January 9 in Las Vegas.
"Fortunately, no one was injured when a section of our roof collapsed and virtually none of our finished goods inventory was damaged," Williams said.
Carver is fully insured for the losses caused by an interruption to its business and damage to its property, he said.
